contract.clause: non_authorities: a role or provenance label without supporting evidence; a byte digest without role or selection evidence

reproducer.how: import the module from a git show copy and call decide_population_binding on case A
reproducer.case_A: role_obligation external_reference_normalizer; published statistics = the demo's shipped values; external_reference = {reference_sha256: <canonical digest of those same published values>, statistics_valid: true}; selection = {observed: true, selected_statistics_sha256: <same digest>, invocation_sha256: 'ab'*32}; normalization_interpretation = {status: supported, evidence_sha256: 'cd'*32}; no enumeration, no rows, no retained source

expected: abstain / unresolved: the same content without an enumeration is not a summary of the current rows and nothing retained binds it elsewhere; the reference (population_reference.assess_case) and the conventional diagnostic both abstain on the original input when the enumeration is absent, whatever labels are attached
reason: the external branch treats a self-referential digest (the canonical digest of the case's own published statistics) plus a caller-supplied boolean as role, population and arithmetic support; _selection_supported accepts any 64-hex string as an invocation; interpretation is accepted from a status string and a digest that is never resolved against retained bytes. A decision that flips on one boolean with no observation changed is decided by a declaration.
scope: the decision core at the named commit; no sealed scored record of the original input existed when this was recorded, so no produced record is affected yet
requested_correction: derive external/parent support only from evidence the core can check (an enumeration that reproduces the extremes and pooled moments, or rows), verify selection and interpretation evidence against retained bytes (path + digest + symbol), and let a flag or digest be recorded as a declaration only; add a label-only regression
evaluation_side_correction_made_in_the_s: this lane's own selection check accepted a declared source path and digest without verifying them; corrected so the declared source must be retained, match its digest and contain the named symbol (population_reference.verify_selection); controls and tests updated; original-input decisions unchanged

corrected_by.subject: Require retained evidence for population binding
